resources.string: Turn On and Unlock Your Ledger
Keep your Ledger on its home screen for now; you\'ll open the Zcash app in a later step. Make sure Bluetooth is on.
On your Ledger, install the Zcash app with Ledger Live if you haven\'t yet, then open it.
When your Ledger asks, approve exporting your account.
Make sure your Ledger is unlocked and Bluetooth is enabled.
Select the Ledger device you\'d like to connect.
Confirm the same pairing code on your phone and on your Ledger if asked.
Waiting for approval on your Ledger
Check your device screen to confirm.
We couldn\'t find any Ledger devices nearby. Make sure your Ledger hardware is unlocked and Bluetooth is turned on.
Unlock your Ledger and open the Zcash app on the device to continue.
We couldn\'t pair with your Ledger. Try again from your device settings.
You declined the request on your Ledger. Approve the account export on your device to continue.
Your Ledger disconnected during setup. Check the connection and try again.
This device can’t use Bluetooth, so it can’t connect to a Ledger device.
Zodl needs Bluetooth access to connect to your Ledger. Turn on Bluetooth in Settings to continue.
Zodl needs Bluetooth access to connect to your Ledger.
Turn on Bluetooth in Settings to continue.
This account is already connected to Zodl.
Bluetooth is off on your device
Turn on Bluetooth in Settings to connect to your Ledger.
The Zcash app on your Ledger is out of date. Update it to version %1$s or newer with Ledger Live, then try again.
The Zcash app isn\'t installed on your Ledger. Install it with Ledger Live, then try again.
You declined opening the Zcash app on your Ledger. Try again and confirm it on the device.
Close and reopen the Zcash app on your Ledger, then try again.
Zodl couldn’t connect to your Ledger. Make sure it’s unlocked and nearby, then try again.
Zodl couldn’t connect to your Ledger.\nMake sure it’s unlocked and nearby, then try again.
Select the Ledger device to sign with.
Sending the transaction to your Ledger…
Confirm the transaction by pressing the two buttons on your Ledger device.
You rejected the transaction on your Ledger. Try again to review it on your device.
Your Ledger disconnected before the transaction was signed. Check the connection and try again.
This isn\'t the Ledger this account was connected with. Connect that Ledger and try again.
Your Ledger can\'t sign this transaction. Nothing was sent.
This account isn\'t paired with a Ledger on this phone. Pair your Ledger to sign this transaction.
Your Ledger is connected and ready to use.
